verdict.rationale: Authy's own features page says the app runs on the Apple Watch, so smartwatch access to codes is a first-party capability. However, it is a single marketing line with no further detail, and nothing in the evidence contradicts it. Missing for 10: detailed docs on how codes are shown on the watch and whether it works independently of the phone, any non-Apple (e.g. Wear OS) smartwatch support, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an everyday user, I can read my codes from my smartwatch without pulling out my phone

citations.quote: On any device. Your phone, tablet, even your Apple Watch.
